title: Coordenador/a Financeiro/a (Atuação em Obras)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Coordenador/a Financeiro/a para atuar em uma de nossas obras na região de Salvador/BA. Este/a profissional orientará decisões financeiras estratégicas alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto, assegurando a eficiência dos recursos , tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Assegurar o correto funcionamento dos controles internos de contas a pagar e tesouraria, visando o cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras corporativas;
  • Elaborar demonstrações financeiras (DRE, BP, FC), modelos financeiros e análises de viabilidade;
  • Contribuir para gestão de caixa integrada do ambiente em que atua, qualificando e otimizando a programação financeira do projetos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na redução de custos e gestão eficiente do caixa;
  • Dominar os procedimentos e conceitos contábeis, garantindo a correta alocação, os devidos registros de lançamentos, cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras e uso dos manuais de melhores práticas;
  • Apoiar a montagem dos negócios, através do conhecimento das diferentes estruturas societárias (consórcio, SPE, controlada direta e etc.);
  • Dominar os principais impostos incidentes no projeto, buscando a melhor gestão dos fiscal com vistas a manter a Segurança Empresarial;
  • Promover diretrizes orçamentárias, modelos de planejamento, acompanhamento e avaliação de desempenho do projeto, alinhado ao modelo de gestão definido pela Matriz;
  • Garantir assertividade no processo orçamentário, seja pela qualificação das equipes, pelo domínio das ferramentas e sistemas e através do conhecimento das características do ambiente de atuação do projeto, sempre qualificando as informações e propondo novos KPIs para acompanhamento;
  • Representar a companhia junto a terceiros (auditores, sócios, fornecedores, fisco e etc.), dominando os demonstrativos financeiros da operação.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou demais áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação ou MBA nas áreas de Finanças Corporativas, Controladoria, Administração de Negócios ou correlatos;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada em posições de liderança na área de Finanças;
  • Vivência anterior em empresas do ramo de Construção Civil Pesada ou Montagens Industriais será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos avançados dos principais softwares do Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região de Salvador/BA.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
O FB Online é uma plataforma digital que oferece cursos online preparatórios ao ENEM, Medicina, ITA e IME contando com o know-how da Organização Educacional Farias Brito.

Como a sala de aula virtual do Farias Brito, o FB Online pode ser acessado a qualquer momento, de qualquer lugar, por meio de qualquer dispositivo conectado à Internet.


Atribuições e responsabilidades:


-Criar, planejar e executar conteúdos para Instagram, YouTube, TikTok.

-Atualizar e gerenciar o calendário editorial, garantindo consistência e alinhamento estratégico.

-Redigir textos, roteiros curtos, legendas e descrições de acordo com o tom de voz das marcas.

-Participar da concepção e briefing de peças visuais, vídeos e campanhas.

-Atuar na gestão de influenciadores e criadores de conteúdo: mapear, selecionar, negociar, direcionar briefings, acompanhar entregas e mensurar resultados.

-Acompanhar métricas de desempenho e propor melhorias contínuas com base em dados.

-Identificar tendências e trazer ideias criativas e conteúdos inovadores.


Requisitos 


-Experiência prévia como Social Mídia ou funções correlatas;

-Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de redes sociais (Meta Business Suite, Creator Studio, etc.);

-Conhecimento em produção de conteúdo instantâneo via vídeo mobile.

-Conhecimento em métricas e análise de resultados;

-Capacidade de organização e cumprimento de prazos;

-Boa comunicação escrita e criativa;

-Noções de edição de imagem e vídeo (Canva, CapCut ou similares)

title: Clinical Site Manager
description:
Clinical Site Manager – (Ophthalmology & Neurology Focus)

Location: Remote-based


We’re partnering with a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to advancing treatments in Ophthalmology, Neurology , and other complex therapeutic areas. To support several ongoing and upcoming studies, we are seeking a Clinical Site Manager to oversee key investigator sites across LATAM .

This position is offering a unique opportunity to blend operational oversight with strong relationship management at the site level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary sponsor contact for assigned sites and CRO monitors, ensuring high-quality communication and collaboration.
  • Oversee site management activities across multiple studies, including start-up, monitoring, and close-out phases.
  • Drive patient recruitment and retention initiatives, fostering engagement with Principal Investigators and site coordinators.
  • Provide operational oversight of CRO CRAs to ensure adherence to protocol, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Support the sponsor’s clinical operations alignment , ensuring consistency and excellence in study execution.
  • Troubleshoot operational challenges and proactively address site-level issues to maintain study momentum.
  • Ensure proper management of study supplies, documentation, and compliance with GCP and sponsor SOPs.


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Lead CRA , Senior CRA , or Clinical Site Manager with strong independent monitoring and site leadership skills.
  • Therapeutic experience in Ophthalmology and/or Neurology is essential.
  • Additional experience in Immunology, Rare Diseases, or Respiratory indications would be advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of GCP , ICH Guidelines , and regional regulatory requirements across Eastern Europe.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness to travel across assigned countries as required.


Why Join?

  • Play a pivotal role in advancing innovative treatments that make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives.
  • Work in a hands-on, strategic role bridging sponsor oversight and site engagement.
  • Join an international, science-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.



About Planet Pharma:


Planet Pharma is an American parented Employment Business/Agency that provides global staffing services with its head-quarters in Chicago and our EMEA regional office located in Central London. We have invested significantly in creating a robust international platform that enables us to work compliantly in 30+ countries with a current network of 2500+ active contractors globally as well as a very strong permanent / direct hire recruitment offering.


Our specialist knowledge and close relationships with our clients and the wider industry really makes us unique in our field. Just recently we were recognised by FORBES as the 17th best professional staffing firm, and have won multiple awards from industry accredited bodies for our commitment to excellence and service delivery. We have extensive functional expertise including: Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, QA, QC, Submissions experts, Clinical development, Quality, Biostatistics, and Medical Affairs / Writing.


We are an equal opportunities Recruitment Business and Agency. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile
description:
A TribeMD Assist busca um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile proativo(a) e talentoso(a) para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de seu aplicativo, com foco em experiência fluida, segura e de alta performance para médicos e pacientes. A vaga é para trabalho presencial em Lajeado (RS) ou remoto.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades para iOS e Android.
  • Otimizar desempenho, corrigir bugs e garantir estabilidade.
  • Colaborar com designers UX/UI e equipe de back-end.
  • Garantir qualidade do código com boas práticas, testes e code reviews.
  • Gerenciar publicações nas lojas (App Store e Google Play).
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis. 


Requisitos obrigatórios:


  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Proficiência em React Native, Flutter ou nativo (Swift/Kotlin).
  • Conhecimento em APIs RESTful, JSON, gerenciamento de estado e Git.
  • Familiaridade com publicação em iOS/Android.
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe. 


Diferenciais:


  • Testes automatizados, CI/CD, integração de módulos nativos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ou no setor de saúde (Health Tech).


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo.
  • Ambiente inovador, colaborativo e com foco em autonomia.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento profissional.


Ideal para quem é apaixonado por mobile e quer impactar positivamente a saúde digital.

title: Business Developer PtX
description:
Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

title: Coordenador de Analytics  - Prevenção a Fraudes
description:
Um pouco sobre nós:


A TotalPass é uma empresa que oferece benefícios corporativos para o bem estar, proporcionando acesso à diversos serviços como academias, estúdios especializados em corrida, boxe, yoga, ciclismo, treinos funcionais coletivos e desenvolvimento muscular. Temos prazer em descomplicar a vida dos nossos clientes com as nossas soluções e fazemos isso de uma forma colaborativa, em um ambiente desafiador.

Acreditamos que o bem-estar existe quando olhamos para a saúde física e mental de maneira leve, livre e integral, e ampliamos diariamente nosso olhar para entender diferentes frentes de saúde agindo juntas. Tudo isso para que as pessoas se sintam seguras em um ambiente onde é possível equilibrar o físico e o mental, de acordo com as possibilidades de suas próprias rotinas.


Como é o time de Dados em Prevenção a Fraude?


Nosso time de Dados em Prevenção a Fraude atua de maneira analítica observando padrões e comportamentos para manter nosso aplicativo cada vez mais seguro. Hoje tem participação expressiva nos resultados da área de tecnologia. Trabalhamos em um ambiente que valoriza a comunicação aberta, a inovação e o desenvolvimento contínuo.


Como será o seu dia a dia?


  • Coordenar uma equipe multidisciplinar de cientistas e analistas de dados voltada para a prevenção e combate a fraudes;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, a implementação e a manutenção de modelos de machine learning e algoritmos preditivos para identificação de comportamentos suspeitos;
  • Supervisionar a construção e otimização de dashboards, relatórios e KPIs para monitoramento contínuo de fraudes e riscos operacionais;
  • Garantir a qualidade, escalabilidade e desempenho das soluções analíticas desenvolvidas;
  • Facilitar a integração dos modelos e indicadores às plataformas internas (com foco em ambientes de nuvem como AWS);
  • Atuar como ponte entre a equipe técnica e as áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Propor e liderar iniciativas de inovação e melhoria contínua na área de dados aplicada à prevenção a fraudes;
  • Fomentar uma cultura de dados, promovendo boas práticas e capacitação contínua da equipe;
  • Garantir a governança e documentação dos modelos e processos analíticos implementados.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Experiência sólida com gestão de times de dados (analytics, data science, BI ou similares);

title: SAP Mobile Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain frontend application features for cross platform mobile SAP Service and Asset Manager.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in development and testing, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, JavaScript, TypeScript, Visual Studio Code, Xcode, Android Studio, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, Java, SAP Business Application Studio, Github, CI/CD with Hyperspace Fastlane, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows, and figma design for the application.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration in frontend logic

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, including unit testing, integration test, and UI automation test scripts for developed features

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, crashes, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead MDK developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role and Reponsabilities:

In this role you will have the chance to build large additions to our platform ecosystem, contributing to an infrastructure that centralizes our ETL and streaming infrastructure, enables experimentation and data development, and powers algorithm development. You will design and build scalable engineering solutions to solve business and data problems.


Core tech stack used by this role:

-S3 using Parquet and Iceberg for data storage

-Hive and Iceberg REST catalog as our metadata store

-Spark (Python, SQL, Scala) for data transformation

-Go, Scala and Java for backend development

-Kafka for data streaming

-Kubernetes and Helm for service deployments

-AWS IAM for access control

-Datadog for logging alerting and monitoring

-Trino as our federated query engine

-Identify, develop, and evangelize tooling, approaches, and data products that raise the bar of validity in experiment design and analyses across the company

-Collaborate with multiple teams and functions to deliver deep-dive analyses and experiment design for new initiatives and high-priority business areas

-Develop and iterate on our processes to empower more efficient and rigorous experimentation


Requirements

-You have a degree in an engineering or computer science field

-You have solid experience in platform engineering, with experience on experimentation platforms

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.
